periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique downward orientation directed toward the snout at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid shape with a visual height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.4:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering at the inferior-medial corner, creating a distinct teardrop profile.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape transition visible at the superior boundary of the dorsal band meeting the white back fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, covering approximately 35% of the visible vertical torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature at the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-red pigmentation/staining of the fur across the abdominal and inguinal regions.
